content.short: Aleno provides real-time on-chain market data.
content.description: Aleno provides real-time, on-chain data for developers, researchers, and enterprises. It specializes in on-demand data feeds, handling data retrieval, transforming raw records into clear metrics, maintaining resilient data pipelines, and delivering results in the user's preferred format. The offering spans asset prices, total value locked (TVL), cross-chain and cross-protocol data, and in-depth market analysis. All data is sourced directly from on-chain activity to ensure accuracy, reliability, and timely decision making.
